items.title: Etio
items.summary: A financial reporting co-pilot for insurance regulatory closes, where deterministic code makes every number and the model supplies the language around them. By Ari Joury Project page: https://towardsdatascience.com/shipai/projects/etio ShipAI is a Towards Data Science project. You can learn more about it here: https://towardsdatascience.com/shipai/about Key takeaways. 1. A deterministic renderer fills text slots from the ledger and aborts the whole render if any slot fails to bind. 2. Triage clusters findings by walking fact lineage with graph traversal, not a model, surfacing one root cause over 20 symptoms. 3. The verifier is attacked in CI across seven error classes, each locked to a baseline of zero misses. items.title: EvidenceDesk
items.summary: A claim-review workspace built with Codex: a technical writer puts a draft beside its sources, and keyword and rule checks flag claims the sources don't back. By Benjamin Nweke Project page: https://towardsdatascience.com/shipai/projects/evidence-desk ShipAI is a Towards Data Science project. You can learn more about it here: https://towardsdatascience.com/shipai/about Key takeaways. 1. It flags metric confusion, like a draft claiming a 20% accuracy gain where the source reports 20% less error. 2. No language model decides: shared keywords retrieve up to three passages per sentence, then targeted rules check the wording. 3. A false mismatch on the builder's own published article led to a tighter rule: one percentage, closely matching context. items.title: AI-Enabled Contracts Comparison
items.summary: Compares two credit agreements section by section, using structure-aware vector indexing and two-stage retrieval, then rates each discrepancy's severity and risk direction. By Partha Sarkar Project page: https://towardsdatascience.com/shipai/projects/contract-comparison ShipAI is a Towards Data Science project. You can learn more about it here: https://towardsdatascience.com/shipai/about Key takeaways. 1. Given a criterion, it takes 10 relevant sections from the first contract and matches up to three from the second. 2. PDFs become Markdown and a skeleton tree, so chunks never cross sections; vector recall plus LLM ranking does the matching. 3. Each pair gets a severity, risk direction and analysis; Texas Roadhouse's missing setoff sharing was flagged significant. items.summary_html:
NVIDIA just dropped Nemotron 3 Diarization, a 100M-parameter open model that tells apart up to 8 speakers in real-time streaming audio. Pair it with a speech-to-text model like Parakeet and every line of your meeting notes knows who said it. It runs entirely locally, so your audio never leaves your machine.

How it works:
- Every fraction of a second, it decides which of 8 speakers is talking, even when two people talk at once
- Speakers are numbered in the order they first show up
- A small speaker memory keeps the labels stable when someone comes back later
